archive: lro_data/trk/lro_no_01 (LRO USN UTDF, day directories YYYYDDD)

development.use: fit, model selection, tuning, editing rules and diagnostics (F1-F3). Results on these days are not independent validation.

holdout.use: one-time frozen evaluation (WP5.4) only, after F1-F4; the pipeline commit SHA, model, editing, priors and solver are fixed in a predeclaration before the data are downloaded or read

unseal.rule: required_value stays null until the WP5.4 predeclaration is committed; it is then set to that predeclaration's path, in the same commit

rule: A predeclaration names its tuning days and its scoring days from 'development'; the same day is never used for both (amendment log, WP0.2).
